## Privacy, accessibility, and wellbeing

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unrelated refactors
- [ ] Behavioral changes were developed test-first, and tests or documentation were updated where needed
- [ ] No disposable build output, coverage, reports, or caches are included; any visual baselines are intentional test fixtures
- [ ] Authored prose, comments, and commit-message paragraphs are not hard-wrapped mid-sentence, and authored files are ASCII-only
- [ ] No secrets or personal browsing data are included
